senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of angaria or parangaria) public service.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 79a">Yeb. 79ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 5:29">I Kings V, 29</cite>) <he>ודילמא ר׳ בעלמא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D00185"><he>דוגזר</he></cite>) but perhaps it was merely for public service (that Israelites were employed, but not as slaves)? <cite ref="Bava Batra 122a:9">B. Bath. 122ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 48:19">Ez. XLVIII, 19</cite>, to prove that the Nasi was to receive a share in the land equal to one of the tribal shares) <he>אימא ר׳ בעלמא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="D00223"><he>דוזגר</he></cite>; ed. Pes. a. oth. <he>אנגר</he>, <he>אונגר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) may I not say that the verse quoted refers merely to public service (due to the Nasi)?—[The reading <cite ref="T00340"><he>רוזגר</he></cite>, from which <cite ref="D00223"><he>דוזגר</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00185"><he>דוגזר</he></cite> &c. arose, is due to a derivation, ascribed to R. Ḥan., from the Persian <cite ref="T00340"><he>רוזגר</he></cite> servitium, v. Vullers 78ᵇ.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 154">Yalk. Sam. 154</cite>, however, has an entirely different reading of Yeb. l. c.].
